text:
We can't say for the whole period. The evidence is insufficient because of a temporal gap.

From 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-24, none of the four sensors (MODIS, VIIRS NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and S-NPP) recorded a NASA FIRMS thermal detection intersecting the asset (count 0).

The last two days, 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-25, are not covered by any sensor. They fall after the latest near-real-time file update, because the day was in progress or the data not yet published. So the full period doesn't meet the rule that every day must be covered.

Even for the covered days, this doesn't prove that no fire occurred. Small, short, cool or cloud-obscured fires may go undetected. The evidence also says nothing about burned area or about dates outside the period.

To close the gap, re-check once the data for 24–25 October is published.
